ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

6. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 23
   C. 30
   D. 120

11. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 6
   C. 15
   D. 9

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 88

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

14. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 9

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 27

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

18. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

20. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 56

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

22. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

24. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
